calls.title: GrowthBook proposal
calls.summary: During the meeting, the team secured a $184,000 two-year contract agreement, involving 110 users at a rate of $92 per user annually, with upfront payment each year. Budget reallocation from the Salesforce project was confirmed, allowing the deal to proceed without new fund approvals, minimizing procurement risks. Legal reviews and document exchanges were scheduled to facilitate contract signing by the next day, aiming for stability with a September rollout after August vacations. Key participants expressed trust and a commitment to a long-term partnership, while emphasizing the platform’s ROI potential and strategic value.
calls.keywords: contract negotiation, budget allocation, two-year agreement, user license pricing, legal review, solution deployment timing
